parameters.query:
WITH cfg AS (
  SELECT body, sha256 FROM triage.config WHERE name = 'config.yaml'
),
rules AS (
  SELECT sha256 FROM triage.config WHERE name = 'rules.js'
),
-- The ruleset names the rules and config this run triages with. Verdicts are
-- kept per ruleset, so a changed rules.js or config.yaml re-triages open PRs.
active AS (
  SELECT 'r' || left(rules.sha256, 12) || '.c' || left(cfg.sha256, 12) AS ruleset FROM cfg, rules
),
run AS (
  INSERT INTO triage.runs (started, ruleset) VALUES (now(), (SELECT ruleset FROM active)) RETURNING id, ruleset
),
-- Same pattern as reposFromConfigLine() in rules.js; the Triage node checks they agree.
repos AS (
  SELECT btrim(r, ' "''') AS repo
  FROM cfg, regexp_split_to_table((regexp_match(E'\n' || cfg.body, '\nrepos:\s*\[([^\]\n]*)\]'))[1], ',') AS r
),
-- Only an ETag stored under this ruleset: a 304 from an older one would skip the re-triage.
last AS (
  SELECT list_etags, started FROM triage.runs
  WHERE finished IS NOT NULL AND ruleset = (SELECT ruleset FROM active)
  ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  run.id AS run_id,
  run.ruleset,
  repos.repo,
  -- R11: a render that finished since the last run started skips the ETag, so
  -- this run reads every open PR and its comment can show the result.
  CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM triage.render_requests rq
                    WHERE rq.repo = repos.repo AND rq.finished > (SELECT started FROM last))
       THEN NULL ELSE (SELECT list_etags ->> repos.repo FROM last) END AS list_etag,
  cfg.body AS config_body,
  cfg.sha256 AS config_sha,
  (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(pattern ORDER BY pattern), '[]'::json) FROM triage.redaction_patterns) AS patterns,
  -- A head SHA is done once it has a verdict under this ruleset, or a finalised one under any.
  (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(DISTINCT repo || '#' || pr || '@' || head_sha), '[]'::json)
     FROM triage.verdicts
     WHERE created > now() - interval '90 days'
       AND (ruleset = run.ruleset OR finalised_at IS NOT NULL)) AS seen,
  -- The latest verdict per head SHA, with each check's result, so the Triage node
  -- can carry an unchanged result forward. A carried row's checks come from the
  -- full row it names, and id is that full row.
  (SELECT coalesce(json_object_agg(k, p), '{}'::json) FROM (
     SELECT DISTINCT ON (v.repo, v.pr, v.head_sha)
       v.repo || '#' || v.pr || '@' || v.head_sha AS k,
       json_build_object(
         'id', coalesce(v.carried_from, v.id),
         'verdict', v.verdict,
         'results', (SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('id', c ->> 'id', 'result', c ->> 'result') ORDER BY n)
                       FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(v.checks, src.checks)) WITH ORDINALITY AS e (c, n))) AS p
     FROM triage.verdicts v
     LEFT JOIN triage.verdicts src ON src.id = v.carried_from
     WHERE v.created > now() - interval '90 days'
     ORDER BY v.repo, v.pr, v.head_sha, v.id DESC) latest) AS previous,
  -- write_mode labels: what was published (or planned) per head SHA.
  (SELECT coalesce(json_object_agg(p.repo || '#' || p.pr || '@' || p.head_sha, json_build_object(
       'verdict', p.verdict, 'ruleset', p.ruleset, 'label', p.label, 'comment_id', p.comment_id,
       'status_state', p.status_state, 'human_override', p.human_override, 'outcome', p.outcome)), '{}'::json)
     FROM triage.publications p
     WHERE p.planned_at > now() - interval '90 days' OR p.published_at > now() - interval '90 days') AS publications,
  -- When the poll last saw each head SHA of each PR. Label events from before
  -- the last sighting of another head SHA belong to that earlier commit.
  (SELECT coalesce(json_object_agg(k, s), '{}'::json) FROM (
     SELECT repo || '#' || pr AS k, json_object_agg(head_sha, seen) AS s FROM (
       SELECT repo, pr, head_sha, max(t) AS seen FROM (
         SELECT repo, pr, head_sha, created AS t FROM triage.verdicts WHERE created > now() - interval '90 days'
         UNION ALL
         SELECT repo, pr, head_sha, planned_at FROM triage.publications WHERE planned_at > now() - interval '90 days'
       ) u GROUP BY 1, 2, 3) per_sha GROUP BY 1) per_pr) AS sha_seen,
  -- The current verdict per head SHA: under this ruleset, else finalised under any.
  (SELECT coalesce(json_object_agg(k, c), '{}'::json) FROM (
     SELECT DISTINCT ON (v.repo, v.pr, v.head_sha)
       v.repo || '#' || v.pr || '@' || v.head_sha AS k,
       json_build_object('verdict', v.verdict, 'reasons', v.reasons, 'ruleset', v.ruleset) AS c
     FROM triage.verdicts v
     WHERE v.created > now() - interval '90 days' AND (v.ruleset = run.ruleset OR v.finalised_at IS NOT NULL)
     ORDER BY v.repo, v.pr, v.head_sha, coalesce(v.ruleset = run.ruleset, false) DESC, v.id DESC) cur) AS current_verdicts,
  -- The GitHub App's identifiers (seed.sql).
  (SELECT body FROM triage.config WHERE name = 'github-app-id') AS app_id,
  (SELECT body FROM triage.config WHERE name = 'github-app-installation-id') AS installation_id
FROM run
LEFT JOIN cfg ON true
LEFT JOIN repos ON true;

nodes.name: One item per PR
nodes.notes: A 304 or an empty list gives no items; alwaysOutputData then passes one empty placeholder, so Triage still runs.

nodes.name: Cluster version
nodes.notes: Runs the unsaved sub-workflow that reads the service-account token, so the token never enters this workflow's saved run data.

parameters.query:
-- A carried row (checks 'null', carried_from set) records that this ruleset gave
-- the same verdict and check results as the full row it names. finalise is set
-- only for a human verdict whose R9 passed.
INSERT INTO triage.verdicts (run_id, repo, pr, head_sha, verdict, reasons, checks, ruleset, carried_from, finalised_at)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6::jsonb, NULLIF($7::jsonb, 'null'::jsonb), $8, NULLIF($9::bigint, 0),
        CASE WHEN $10::boolean THEN now() END)
ON CONFLICT (repo, pr, head_sha, ruleset) DO NOTHING;

nodes.name: Write gate
nodes.notes: The only path to TriagePublishV01, the one place that writes to GitHub. write_mode comes from config.yaml.

parameters.query:
-- Runs last (the lowest branch): the publish branch has finished. publish sums
-- up this run's plans; a failed write clears the ETags, so the next run reads
-- every PR again and retries.
WITH s AS (
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN $5 = 'off' THEN 'planned-only'
    WHEN NOT $6::boolean THEN 'skipped-unhealthy'
    WHEN bool_or(outcome IN ('failed', 'publishing')) THEN 'failed'
    WHEN bool_or(outcome = 'redaction-hit') THEN 'redaction-hit'
    WHEN bool_or(outcome = 'published') THEN 'published'
    ELSE 'no-op' END AS publish
  FROM triage.publications WHERE run_id = $1
)
UPDATE triage.runs
SET finished = now(),
    pr_count = (SELECT count(*) FROM triage.verdicts WHERE run_id = $1),
    negative_control = $2,
    publish = s.publish,
    ok = $3 AND s.publish <> 'failed',
    list_etags = CASE WHEN s.publish = 'failed' THEN '{}'::jsonb ELSE $4::jsonb END
FROM s
WHERE id = $1;

nodes.name: PR comments
nodes.notes: Only when the stored comment is missing or not the App's comment for this head SHA: every page, searched by marker and App author.

parameters.query:
-- One row per open PR head SHA. The published columns are left alone here;
-- Record publish sets them once every write read back as sent.
INSERT INTO triage.publications (repo, pr, head_sha, planned, planned_at, run_id, outcome, human_override, override_actor, override_label)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4::jsonb, now(), $5, $6, $7::boolean, NULLIF($8, ''), NULLIF($9, ''))
ON CONFLICT (repo, pr, head_sha) DO UPDATE
  SET planned = excluded.planned,
      planned_at = excluded.planned_at,
      run_id = excluded.run_id,
      outcome = excluded.outcome,
      human_override = triage.publications.human_override OR excluded.human_override,
      override_actor = coalesce(excluded.override_actor, triage.publications.override_actor),
      override_label = coalesce(excluded.override_label, triage.publications.override_label);

nodes.name: Publish
nodes.notes: Runs the unsaved sub-workflow once per write. It returns statuses and IDs only, never a token. A failed write is recorded, never retried here.

parameters.query:
-- The published columns move only when every write read back as sent. A
-- comment that was written is kept either way, so a retry edits it rather than
-- posting another.
UPDATE triage.publications p
SET outcome = $5,
    comment_id = coalesce(NULLIF($6::bigint, 0), p.comment_id),
    verdict = CASE WHEN $5 = 'published' THEN p.planned ->> 'verdict' ELSE p.verdict END,
    ruleset = CASE WHEN $5 = 'published' THEN p.planned ->> 'ruleset' ELSE p.ruleset END,
    label = CASE WHEN $5 = 'published' THEN p.planned ->> 'label' ELSE p.label END,
    status_state = CASE WHEN $5 = 'published' THEN coalesce(p.planned -> 'status' ->> 'state', p.status_state) ELSE p.status_state END,
    published_at = CASE WHEN $5 = 'published' THEN now() ELSE p.published_at END
WHERE p.run_id = $1 AND p.repo = $2 AND p.pr = $3 AND p.head_sha = $4;

nodes.name: Renders

parameters.query:
-- R11: this head SHA's render requests, with both renders' digests, and the
-- R11 result the last plan stored for it. The rendered docs come only for a
-- request whose result that plan hasn't stored under this ruleset, so each
-- render is read about once. Always one row per PR (a placeholder gets []).
WITH cache AS (
  SELECT p.planned -> 'r11' AS r11
  FROM triage.publications p
  WHERE p.repo = $2 AND p.pr = NULLIF($3, '')::integer AND p.head_sha = $4
    AND p.planned -> 'r11' ->> 'ruleset' = $5
)
SELECT
  NULLIF($1, '') AS key,
  (SELECT r11 FROM cache) AS cache,
  (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object(
      'id', rq.id, 'path', rq.path, 'release', rq.release, 'chart', rq.chart,
      'old_version', rq.old_version, 'new_version', rq.new_version,
      'status', rq.status, 'error', rq.error, 'attempts', rq.attempts,
      'old', (SELECT json_build_object('digest', r.chart_digest, 'app_version', r.app_version, 'bytes', r.bytes)
                FROM triage.renders r WHERE r.request_id = rq.id AND r.side = 'old'),
      'new', (SELECT json_build_object('digest', r.chart_digest, 'app_version', r.app_version, 'bytes', r.bytes)
                FROM triage.renders r WHERE r.request_id = rq.id AND r.side = 'new'),
      'docs', CASE WHEN rq.status IN ('done', 'failed') AND NOT EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1 FROM cache, jsonb_array_elements(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(cache.r11 -> 'results') = 'array'
                                                                 THEN cache.r11 -> 'results' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) c
                  WHERE c ->> 'id' = rq.id::text AND c ->> 'status' = rq.status AND c ->> 'state' = 'done')
                THEN (SELECT json_object_agg(r.side, r.docs) FROM triage.renders r WHERE r.request_id = rq.id) END
    ) ORDER BY rq.id), '[]'::json)
   FROM triage.render_requests rq
   WHERE rq.repo = $2 AND rq.pr = NULLIF($3, '')::integer AND rq.head_sha = $4) AS requests;

nodes.notes: R11: the render requests and stored result for this head SHA. Read-only.

parameters.query:
-- R11: one request per HelmRelease chart bump on a head SHA. One already
-- queued is left as it is. An unsupported one is finished on insert.
INSERT INTO triage.render_requests (repo, pr, head_sha, path, release, namespace, chart, helm_repo_url,
                                    old_version, new_version, kube_version, status, error, finished)
VALUES ($1, $2::integer, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, NULLIF($8, ''), $9, $10, NULLIF($11, ''), $12::text, NULLIF($13, ''),
        CASE WHEN $12::text = 'unsupported' THEN now() END)
ON CONFLICT (repo, pr, head_sha, path, release) DO NOTHING;
